# اِحْتَرَقْتَ (iḥtaraqta) /iħ.ta.raq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
# اِحْتَرَقْتِ (iḥtaraqti) /iħ.ta.raq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
# اِحْتَرَقَتْ (iḥtaraqat) /iħ.ta.ra.qat/: third-perso
